credits_text: Stories to amuse the fantastically bored, uncaring youth of the techno age. Starring Jason Brener as "The Scarecrow". Cast includes Maria Malzone, Marika MacKenzie, Kelly Houckman, Wyatt Boswell, Vigi Skara, Doc Bacouet, Vlad Puschino, and others. Directed by Adam Markus. Produced by Walter Markus.
other_text: Early Morning Films Productions Presents a Walter Markus Film. RETURN OF THE SCARECROW.
description: A poster features a scarecrow figure in a wide-brimmed hat and dark clothing, with additional scarecrow figures in the background and a group of people around a campfire in a dark, wooded setting.
